item.tib: yid ches lung gi sgron ma
item.coloph: lho brag khom mthing 'byams (('gram) shing gi gtsug lag khang gi sgo srung / rta 'bring gi 'dir so dmar po la/ bka'i bya ra ma la gnyer gtad nas/ snyan rgyud rnam gnyis sgron ma dang bcas pa/ bla ma jo sde la/ gter bdag gis lung bstan nas/ gter nas byung zhing dngos grub bab po/ bsnyan (snyan) rgyud chen mo ni zab 'dzin mdzad cing mang bar ma spel/ chung ba zhu ba rnams spel bar bstan/ a po sngon po la sogs pa btang pas/ zur chos bon la chos su bsgyar/ thugs kyi snying po bya bar btag nas/ da lta spyod/ lung sgron rgyas pa nas/ bla ma snya chen po'i yon tan dang / rgyas pa'i skyes rabs dang / mdzad pa'i 'phrin las dang*/ snyan rgyud gter nas thon lugs/ rgyas par yod do/ 'dir ma yin no/ rim par brgyud nas g.yo ston zhig po 'brug sgra can la brgyud do/ rang grol bla ma rgyal mtshan la rko (ko) bo ye shes rgyal mtshan/ zhu rin chen rnam rgyal phyag dpe'o//
